assets.name: library-room.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: immersive background for the first screen of a literary reading web app, landscape 3:2 composition, one coherent room photograph.
Primary request: A modest, intimate Korean personal library / writing room, photographed with warm fine-grain film and a very subtle painterly texture. Dark walnut wood bookshelves around the room hold assorted well-loved vintage books with plain, unlettered spines. Cream plaster walls, delicate dust floating in afternoon sunlight entering from a window on the left. Warm, quiet, lived-in and understated, carefully observed material textures.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal 3:2 image, calm frontal view with gentle natural perspective. Reserve generous clean deep brown/shadow negative space in the left upper-middle area for a website title that will be added later. In the center-right, a low broad walnut book shelf or cabinet has a clear empty horizontal top surface and visible space above it, intended for a single front-facing book that will be placed with HTML later. Do not put a featured book in this empty display spot. Surrounding books and modest room props should frame the clear center-right display area without crowding it. The lower shelf surface is grounded and believable. Left window light produces warm directional illumination and subtle shadows. Avoid a bright white hotspot behind the left text area.
Style/medium: refined warm film photograph with subtle painterly surface detail, realistic depth and grain, elegant muted cream, walnut, honey and shadow colors, no oversaturated orange, no excessive clutter.
Constraints: no people, no readable text, no letters on books, no words, no logos, no watermark, no computer or phone screens, no UI, no posters with writing. This is only the room background, not a website mockup.

The author credit should be about 24 pixels high at this cover size and located about one line of space below the subtitle, around y=560.
All existing text must remain completely unchanged: title on two lines "잘 지내냐고" and "물으면"; subtitle "대답이 조금 길어질 것 같다".
Change only the addition of "김승제 지음"; do not move, rewrite, enlarge, replace, or redraw any existing text or illustration. No extra text, logos, border, or watermark.
